text: Parks and Recreation staff will give a presentation on the Toronto Island Master Plan, including highlights of short- and long-term investments in Toronto Island, improvements to Visitor Experience, and the approach to investment at Hanlan’s Point and to celebrating 2SLGBTQ+ significance. Additionally, staff will share updates on ongoing opportunities for community engagement.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
